text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN, WHEAT AND SOYBEAN SALES - South Korea bought at least 220,400 tonnes of grains and oilseeds through tenders and private negotiations during October. These included 52,500 tonnes of corn, 51,400 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 51,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean, 52,000 tonnes of feed wheat, 12,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal and 1,500 tonnes of Canadian mixed feed oats. The total figure compares with total purchases of 895,000 tonnes in September.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - The Japanese Food Agency said on Thursday it had bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 40,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat, 20,000 tonnes of Australian wheat and 40,000 tonnes of Canadian barley at its weekly tender, all for December shipment.
VEGOIL SALE - The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan has bought 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil at $512.90 per tonne FOB for shipment in the second half of November, dealers said on Thursday.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it was tendering on November 6 for up to 10,000 tonnes of northern spring wheat for donation to Ghana. CCC said it was also seeking up to 1,600 tonnes of hard red winter wheat for donation to Benin. The wheat was slated for December 1-25 shipment.
- Pakistan is seeking 200,000 tonnes of U.S. number two or better soft white wheat for Nov 12-30 delivery. Bids will be opened on November 3.

CORN TENDERS - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of one cargo of 18,000 tonnes of maize, with a shipment date of November or December 1996. The tender closes on Tuesday November 5.

- Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group will tender on Friday for one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. corn, local traders said. The shipment would be slated for January 26 to February 10 delivery from the U.S. Gulf or February 11-25 from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Wednesday it was extending until noon (1000 GMT) on November 6 the deadline for bids for 30,000 tonnes U.S. or Argentine yellow corn and 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin. The old deadline was October 30.
COTTONSEED OIL TENDER - South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said it has invited tenders for 30,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal by 11.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Friday.
SOYOIL TENDER - The CCC said it was tendering on November 6 for 13,000 tonnes of bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The oil was slated for Dec 14-30 delivery.

MARKET TALK - Bangladesh is expected to tender for about 200,000 tonnes optional origin wheat during the last week of November, several U.S. exporters said. It would be optional origin and the cheapest wheat, one exporter noted. "I think they are looking at U.S., Australian or Canadian," he said. One shipment of 100,000 tonnes would be for December delivery and the other 100,000 tonnes would be for January, he said.
